[SWS_J1939Tp_00039] ⌈When configured, the transport protocol variant (
BAM/CMDT, see J1939TpTxProtocolType) and the SA/DA (see J1939TpTxSa/
J1939TpTxDa) shall be used for transmission. For N-SDUs with meta data, these
parameters are optional. If SA or DA is not configured, the value provided via the meta
data shall be used. If the transport protocol is not configured, it shall be chosen
based on the actual DA: BAM when DA is 0xFF, CMDT otherwise.⌋
